verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag and remote-config platform, not an AI agent or assistant, so acting as an MCP client that consumes other servers' tools is outside its product role. The documented Flagsmith MCP Server is the opposite role (it serves Flagsmith's API to agents) and cannot be credited toward this client-side story. Nothing in the evidence shows Flagsmith hosting an agent that connects to external MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
